title: It
author: Stephen King
summary: In Derry, Maine, a group of outcast children band together to fight a shape-shifting creature that preys on the town's young. Twenty-seven years later, the survivors must return and finish what they began.
readIf: you like a long, character-rich horror novel that is as much about childhood friendship as about fear.
skipIf: you want a short read or are bothered by stories involving harm to children.

pairings.reason: Another King story of a New England town quietly eaten from within by something old.
A far gentler, shorter story about childhood, memory and a supernatural threat.
Horror about a past act that comes back for a group of friends in later life.
